title: XPMagnet
description: Sneak to pull XP orbs toward you, sprint to push them away
body:
# XPMagnet
**A small quality-of-life mod that gives you control over nearby XP orbs**

### Features
- Sneak -> XP orbs fly towards you faster
- Sprint -> XP orbs are pushed away

### Why should I download this mod?
_Great Question!_
Collecting XP can sometimes be slow or messy, especially with many orbs

This mod adds a simple and intuitive way to control them using movement, which makes playing the game more enjoyable

### Details
- Lightweight and performance friendly
- Server only(users won't have to install the mod on the client side)
- No configuration needed, it just works
- Integrates into the Vanilla game without feeling too modded

### Controls
> Sneak - Pull nearby XP orbs
> Sprint - Push nearby XP orbs away

### Compatibility
This mod should be compatible with most modern mods including Sodium, Iris, Lithium, and many more!
